description:
Project Overview
The Rotary Club of Mumbai Khar, under the leadership of President Rtn. Mukesh Sehgal, successfully organised a meaningful Tree Plantation Drive at Chuim Village Community Centre during July 2026.
Approximately 15 Rotarians and Ann’s participated enthusiastically in the initiative, dedicating their morning to environmental conservation, community service and fellowship.
The project aimed not only to contribute towards creating a greener environment, but also to strengthen the Rotary Club’s engagement with the local community.
Chief Guest & Support
The project was graced by Chief Guest Corporator Mrs. Swapna Mhatre, whose wholehearted support and encouragement played an important role in making the initiative possible.
The saplings required for the plantation were generously arranged by Mrs. Mhatre. Her continued willingness to support community welfare initiatives and environmental projects was greatly appreciated by the Rotary Club of Mumbai Khar.
